title: Codex, the Tiny Coder
goal: Codex is a small helper that writes short code in your terminal.
mascot_lines: Codex is a helper made just for writing code.
If you start typing a line, Codex tries to finish it for you.
It knows lots of programming languages and can fix small bugs in seconds.
Try Codex below — type 'write a loop' or 'say hello'.

tier2.rephrase: Codex works step by step in a terminal. Order the steps.

tier3.nudge: First read the wish. Then write code. Then save. Then run!
